description: This file is a shell script designed to retrieve and display configuration information related to port forwarding settings (SPF) from a system context, using a utility called utctx_cmd. It parses input parameters, constructs commands, executes them, and outputs the relevant port forwarding details.

methods.name: do_utctx_get
methods.description: A function that executes the utctx_cmd with a given parameter list and handles error checking.
